versions.name: Norseland Scout Camp
versions.summary: A Twin Valley Council camp on wooded grounds north of St. Peter in southern Minnesota, with rustic year-round campsites, winding trails, and an orienteering course used for weekend unit camping and outdoor-skills events.

sources.citation: Added 2026-08-14 (method: curated) from a coverage gap surfaced by the scout-camp-map project; council/status re-verified from the Twin Valley Council camp page. The scout-camp-map source labeled it a Viking Council property, but Viking Council was retired long ago; the camp is currently the Twin Valley Council's Norseland Scout Camp (Twin Valley has announced a pending merger into Northern Star). Coordinates geocoded via US Census; elevation from open-meteo. Features unsurveyed; July normals pending a WorldClim resample.

provenance.notes: Coverage add: existence, current council, and operating status verified against the council's own camp page; camp_type/program_types classified conservatively as a weekend/troop-camping property; features unsurveyed.
